- **Shaders!**
Sun shadows: cast by blocks in daylight, smoothly through the day. They are on by default in normal mode (distance 64), with soft as an option.
Waving grass and leaves, on by default.
Warm colour grading (warm, cinematic or vivid), done in the block shaders with no extra cost. It is on by default as warm.
Post effects, all off by default: FXAA, bloom on light-emitting blocks, god rays, vignette and camera motion blur.
Visual profiles: Vanilla, Default and Maximum presets (the live tuning panel is on feat/visual-effects-panel, not merged yet).
Client lighting: it now works on every version from 1.17 up, runtime-built from minecraft-data, still behind the experimental flag. The F3 line shows where the light comes from.
Fixes and perf: nearest chunks mesh and reveal first, light-only column reloads are coalesced per frame, and the clouds no longer vanish for a frame at cell borders. [`df8cb9e`](/commit/df8cb9e042a9b0ca7300ede1270dc1555b4306b7)
- F3 shows where the light comes from
The Light line now comes from the renderer's own light data and shows the
lighting mode, like zardoy/minecraft-web-client[#304](/issues/304):
"Light: 13 (15 sky) (Client Engine)" / "(Server Lighting)" /
"(Lighting Disabled)". Falls back to the bot's light values when the
renderer does not provide it.
Needs the renderer branch feat/runtime-light-tables
(getLightingDebugInfo, formatLightingLine).

Needs the renderer branch feat/shader-effects (RENDERER_VISUAL_PROFILES,
RENDERER_EFFECT_OPTION_KEYS and the new effect options).

- a link with both ?texturepack= and ?mapDir= (or ?map=) installs the resource pack, then opens the map
downloadAndOpenMapFromUrl returned from the map branches before it looked at the texture pack, so with both parameters the pack was silently ignored. Now the pack is installed first (the texturepack-only path), then the map opens.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com> [`1716fba`](/commit/1716fba9decf27641e082889d8d6776256bfc17f)
- installing a resource pack from a link (?texturepack=) before a world is open no longer fails with "No config loaded"
completeResourcepackPackInstall called updateTextures, which needs the resources manager config that only exists once a world is starting. A ?texturepack= link (alone or together with ?mapDir=) installs the pack first, so the install threw and the loading screen showed the error. The files are already in place and the pack is enabled right after, so the textures are built from it when the world starts: only that one error is tolerated.

- prod server answered 404 for the wasm mesher (CI smoke test failing since [#625](/issues/625)) ([#626](/issues/626))
- prod server answered 404 for the wasm mesher, breaking client light and the singleplayer smoke test
server.js routed /wasm_mesher.js and /wasm_mesher_bg.wasm to minecraft-renderer/public/, which the published package does not ship, so with a full
node_modules (CI's pnpm prod-start, local prod runs) the wasm was a 404 instead of the copy in dist/. Since lighting is on by default ([#625](/issues/625)) the client
light worker needs it: it failed to start, 4 of 49 chunks never finished and the Cypress 'Loads & renders singleplayer' test timed out on next.
The routes are now registered only when the file exists (a file: renderer checkout); otherwise dist/ is served.
